name: io.github.berkingurcan/stellar-agent-mcp
title: Stellar Agent MCP
description: Discover, rank, and verify Stellar 8004 agents through a read-only, keyless MCP server and CLI.

environmentVariables.name: STELLAR_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Stellar network to target: mainnet | testnet. testnet also requires EXPLORER_BASE_URL — the default explorer indexes mainnet only, and the server refuses to start on the mismatched pair.

environmentVariables.name: EXPLORER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the stellar-8004 explorer API base URL.

environmentVariables.name: STELLAR_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Soroban RPC URL used for on-chain reputation verification.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_ONCHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable on-chain reputation verification (degrade to self-declared explorer data only).
